summary: Created ncs-training-mcp-builder skill, added supplemental CSV schema/importer/harness/tests, imported three CSV sources into separate tables.
Added context-only supplemental CSV evidence to compact NCS training recommendations; verified with 162 tests, lint, smoke, ontology validate, and quality gates fail_count 0.

Hardened transition scenario review gates: added expected recall floor, forced top1 for trusted targets, promoted one passing candidate_auto scenario, verified trusted transition quality gates fail_count 0.

Analyzed korean-law-mcp reference zip and implemented first NCS benchmark pattern: ncs_discover_tools, ncs_execute_tool, compact registry metadata, docs update, and read-only meta execution policy. Verified lint, smoke, and 56 targeted tests.
Added FastMCP streamable-http support, /health route, HTTP run script and MCP HTTP config. Verified real HTTP health response, py_compile, targeted health test, lint, and smoke.
Added protocol-level MCP STDIO smoke script. Verified initialize, tools/list, and tools/call against the live NCS MCP server with 13 exposed tools and required meta/recommendation tools present.

Added MCP operational hardening: secret masking, specific not-found codes, TypeError classification, read-only meta save enforcement, and first-class tool registry. Addressed reviewer findings and verified 62 related tests, lint, STDIO smoke, and smoke.

Added reference-grade packaging: Dockerfile, .dockerignore, GitHub Actions CI for unit/lint/STDIO smoke and Docker build, and Docker usage docs. Verified py_compile, 62 related tests, lint, STDIO smoke, and smoke; Docker CLI unavailable locally so image build is delegated to CI.

Added structured MCP error-code catalog and docs. error_response now includes category/retryable/severity/description/known while preserving specific not-found codes and secret masking. Verified py_compile, targeted error tests, 62 related tests, lint, STDIO smoke, and smoke.

Added public MCP tool contract generated from tool_registry.py, committed mcp/ncs-tool-contract.json, and wired CI stale-contract check. Verified py_compile, contract check, lint, 62 related tests, STDIO smoke, and smoke.

Added /health runtime diagnostics for DB existence and API-key presence booleans without exposing secrets. Verified targeted HTTP health test, py_compile, lint, STDIO smoke, 62 related tests, and smoke.
Added real HTTP process health smoke script and wired it into CI. Verified HTTP health startup, no secret leakage, STDIO smoke, contract check, lint, 62 related tests, and smoke.

Added bounded external API retry helper for transient request errors and 429/502/503/504; applied to training-course and job-base fetchers. Verified py_compile, retry tests, job-base/training API tests, lint, 65 related tests, contract check, STDIO smoke, HTTP smoke, and smoke.
Added MCP release checklist for secret/data boundaries, verification commands, HTTP/Docker registration, active NCS scope, and compact response policy. Verified lint and tool-contract check.

Ran broad verification after MCP operational hardening: 174-test full suite passed, ontology validate ok with no readiness issues, and quality gates with transition eval had fail_count 0 and warn_count 11.

Added meta-execution compact response policy: recommendation tools default compact=true through ncs_execute_tool unless explicitly overridden, while save=false remains forced. Regenerated tool contract and verified targeted tests, 65 related tests, STDIO smoke, HTTP smoke, and smoke.
Added Korean user-facing MCP guide for the 13 active tools, examples, error interpretation, and release links. Verified lint and tool-contract check.
Added qualification retry hygiene apply path, backfilled 960 historical 429 rows without API calls, added quality gate and reports, verified tests/lint/smoke.
Added recommendation evidence hygiene command, remapped 16 stale training-goal evidence source_ids, reduced quality-gate warnings from 11 to 10, verified tests/lint/smoke/stdio/http.
Fixed sparse-label transition precision gate after typo refinement; quality-gates fail=0 warn=9; MCP STDIO/HTTP smoke passed
Made rule-based quality diagnostics refined-text-aware; criteria_format_issue 6491->328; suspected_typo/double_space pass; quality-gates fail=0 warn=8
Added API mismatch normalization and api-quality-hygiene; resolved 10 duplicate/entity API issues; quality-gates fail=0 warn=7
Added targeted NCS006 retry for open api_element_unmatched issues; 40/40 succeeded; API quality gates pass; total quality-gates fail=0 warn=6
Generated human-review priority, 60-item review seedpack, 3-item transition scenario seedpack, and triage report without auto-approving human_reviewed debt
Retried 330 due qualification error units; qualification error_share now passes; remaining warnings are coverage and true human-review debt
Benchmarked korean-law-mcp zip and added NCS MCP benchmark guidance.
Optimized transition recommendation and seedpack generation; broad tests, lint, quality gates, and MCP smoke passed.

Hardened MCP public/operator surface against korean-law benchmark: default public tools now 10 read-only tools, operator review tools gated by NCS_MCP_ENABLE_OPERATOR_TOOLS=1, contract regenerated, HTTP smoke uses contract count, active review tools added for training-goal links and task-KSA relations, full regression 196 tests/lint/smoke/quality gates passed.

Hardened HTTP/Docker readiness: added DB readiness metadata, strict /ready endpoint, Docker healthcheck now uses /ready, HTTP smoke creates a ready temp DB and checks /health plus /ready, CI Docker job now runs container readiness smoke. Full regression 197 tests/lint/STDIO/HTTP smoke/contract/quality gates passed.

Added release-facing UTF-8 sanity check for README/user guide/release checklist/public contract, added it to CI, verified contract Korean aliases and public tool count, validated CI YAML parse. check_text_encoding/lint/contract passed.

Added release readiness reporting separate from engineering hygiene. Latest report says engineering_hygiene_ok=true but release_ready=false with 6 blockers: human review debt, qualification coverage, and trusted scenario depth. This prevents benchmark readiness from being overstated.

Closed reviewer findings: health transport metadata, portable HTTP launcher, Docker env port wiring, release readiness JSON parity, boundary tests, candidate50 review pack report. Verified full unittest, lint, smoke, MCP protocol checks.
Documented qualification API rate-limit guard in harness/release docs and updated follow-up report; verified UTF-8 text encoding.
Integrated subagent qualification-guard review: propagated repeated 429 attempts into the circuit breaker, added tests, and replaced unsafe public retry examples.
Added operator-doc safety regression tests and regenerated quality/release readiness snapshots after qualification guard review.
